system.description:
Jargon is the specialized speech used by masons, architects and engineers.

Obstacles: Identifying yourself or another as a speaker of the secret language, Ob 1. Communicating plans and instructions, Ob 2. Otherwise, use the skill versus the skill of anyone trying to eavesdrop on the conversation.

Skill Type: Social. Tools: No.

Root: Perception

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 279
